body:
zmux attach <project> <id> [command…] computes the name and the labels from one pair, then execs a configurable launcher whose default is the systemd-run prefix `za` already uses:

  systemd-run --user --scope --collect --quiet  zmx attach --labels 'project=P id=ID' NAME [command…]

Launcher as data (empty means bare zmx), so a host without systemd, a mac, or a caller who wants another supervisor changes one setting and nothing else.

Rationale: d-naming requires labels at creation, and `zmx attach` takes labels only at creation, so the naming path and the labelling path must be the same code. The alternative — keep `za`, let zmux read only — leaves every session created by `za` ungrouped, which is the common case.

This supersedes and subsumes `za`; the shell function should be deleted when the verb exists, not kept alongside it.
title: Absorb za: one verb that names, labels and launches
